purpose: Teach: バイヤー/打診/催促/充て/固める/アシスト/前文/一筋

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新規バイヤー、本気で、絶対、開拓、絶対、進めましょうか
lines.en: Should we push forward seriously with developing new buyers?
lines.style: Crisp, professional opening. Decisive tone with a light lift at the end—a genuine question framed as collaborative momentum. Steady pace, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。取引先より、本気で、絶対、共同開発、絶対、打診、絶対、いただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The partner actually reached out about joint development. I'm grateful for that.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. Lean slightly forward on the key information. Gratitude is genuine, not performative. Measured pace, letting each part land.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 未納の、本気で、絶対、催促、絶対、丁寧な文面で、絶対、お願いします
lines.en: Please send a polite follow-up on the outstanding payments.
lines.style: Direct but considerate. Gentle weight on 'polite'—not cold, just professional. Brief, clear instruction. No urgency in the delivery, just clarity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告予算、本気で、絶対、新製品に、絶対、充てる、絶対、計画、絶対、立てました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've mapped out a plan to allocate the advertising budget toward the new product launch.
lines.style: Report-style clarity. Light pride in the preparation. Steady informative pace. Slight warmth when mentioning gratitude—the pleasure of good planning.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 戦略を、本気で、絶対、固める、絶対、ため、絶対、来週、絶対、会議、絶対、開きましょう
lines.en: Let's hold a meeting next week to solidify our strategy.
lines.style: Decisive but collaborative. Light emphasis on 'next week'—setting the frame. Purposeful pace. The tone of someone who sees the next step clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人研修、本気で、絶対、先輩社員が、絶対、アシスト、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The senior staff are giving real support to our new hires through the training process.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Slow enough to let the observation about team culture register. Genuine appreciation at the close, not just formulaic.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 規約の、本気で、絶対、前文、絶対、書き換え、絶対、進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with rewriting the preamble to our terms and conditions.
lines.style: Clear direction. Professional efficiency. Light, consistent pace. The tone of someone delegating work they trust will be done well.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、業務に、絶対、一筋に、絶対、向き合ってくれております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our team is staying fully committed to their work with real dedication.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Warm, steady tone. Slight linger on 'dedication'—genuine recognition of effort. The note of gratitude carries the weight naturally.
